name: LaunchIgniter

sources.title: Submit entry (form behind flow; pricing page holds the rules)
Launch your product — Free vs Basic $12 vs Pro $15 with full FAQ

conditions: Free launch requires the LaunchIgniter badge on your product homepage (compulsory verification; manual-confirmation fallback if Cloudflare blocks their checker)
Free launches pass manual review ('unique, high quality products' only) and the chosen launch date can move if free slots run out
Free tier gets a dofollow backlink only if it finishes top 3 of the launch week
requirements: Each product can be launched only once — submit when ready
Launches start 00:00 Monday UTC and run exactly 7 days on the homepage
preparation: Product details and a chosen launch week
LaunchIgniter badge embedded on your homepage (free route), plus a note of which page hosts it for manual confirmation if needed
Paid options: Basic $12 one-time (lifetime DR75 dofollow, guaranteed date, no review queue) or Pro $15 one-time (adds dofollow backlinks from StartupTrusted DR57 and SaaSGrow DR59)
workflow: Open /submit and pick Free, Basic, or Pro
Submit product details and choose a launch week
Free: complete badge verification (or tick manual confirmation) and wait for admin review
Launch goes live 00:00 Monday UTC for 7 days of homepage visibility
Top 3 by upvotes earn the Winner badge (and, for Free, the dofollow backlink)
watchFor: Free launch date is not guaranteed — it can shift if the week's free slots fill
One launch per product ever — no relaunches
Cloudflare/bot protection on your site can break automated badge verification; use the manual confirmation checkbox
Pricing page cross-promotes a paid 'Directory Submission' service from $99 — separate upsell, not needed to launch
Sidebar 'permanent featured spot' is another paid option
countsAsLive: Product appears on the LaunchIgniter homepage for its 7-day window starting Monday 00:00 UTC with upvotes enabled; winners later appear under /weekly-winners
unknowns: Whether an account is required before /submit
Whether paid launches are also manually reviewed (page implies instant/no review queue)
